notes.title: Radial Lust Menu & Toilet Survival Patch!
notes.content:
[p]🔥 [b]Hotfixes, Hard-ons & Hilarious Toilets – Oh My![/b][/p][p]Things are heating up in the village, and not just because someone forgot to open a window. The latest update for [i]Naked Lust and Burning Passions[/i] introduces a brand-new [b]radial menu[/b] for interacting with our ever-horny AI companions. For now, they’ll follow you around—or leave you alone if you’re not in the mood (how polite of them!).[/p][p]But wait, there’s more:[/p][p]💦 Fixed that awkward moment when your character tried to perform life cycle animations [i]mid-thrust[/i]. That’s not rebirth, babe, that’s just broken code.[/p][p]🍆 AI now reacts properly when it’s ready for sex. No more standing around like confused virgins at a swinger party.[/p][p]🪪 Fixed the issue with the magical "E" widget that just wouldn’t go away. It’s finally learned to take a hint when you sprint around like a lunatic.[/p][p]🧊 AI shouldn’t freeze anymore. Unless you're into cold lovers—we don’t kink shame, but bugs are bugs.[/p][p]👙 Clothing now saves and loads correctly after restart. Because no one wants to respawn pantsless… unless you [i]chose[/i] that life.[/p][p]🚽 Added a new chat warning when the bathroom is busy:
[b]"The bathroom is occupied and might not survive. Please wait until the situation clears… for your own safety."[/b]
(You’ve been warned.)[/p][p]🎨 Character settings menu now has its "Apply" and "Close" buttons where they actually belong. Finally, someone cleaned up that mess.[/p][p]🪵 Tree distances increased and camera now properly blocked by trees. No more peeping through the branches like a naughty squirrel.[/p][p]🚽 Toilet collision fixed! Also, added proper collision to the chamber pot—because even virtual pee deserves boundaries.[/p][p]🔇 Turned off developer log spam. The game no longer moans in code when you touch it.[/p][p]This update is just the beginning—our village is getting dirtier, smarter, and a lot more fun. So grab your favorite toy (in-game or IRL), get out there, and [b]follow[/b] that AI into depravity.[/p][p]💋 Stay horny, stay curious![/p]
